ValidationRule.description: Only allows users to enter their own name in the Credit Analyst field. Excepts System Administrators and users with permission set OpsLeadership.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Credit_Analyst__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Credit_Analyst__c)), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', NOT($Permission.OpsLeadership), Credit_Analyst__c <> $User.Id )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Users can only enter their own name in the Credit Analyst field.
